name: Bitozeves (Czechia)
description: Three horizontal stripes of red, white and navy blue, with a yellow triangle issuing from the hoist edge reaching half the flag's length.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 25 November 2011 (decision No. 24) and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
